components.description: A set of minimizing locations
components.notes: Definition supplies rho hypotheses, Q_n, argmin set, one-sided derivatives and source midpoint psi convention (source p.76), midpoint estimator and translation equivariance. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Existence, measurability and the correct derivative conditions
components.notes: Annex proves compact interval, strict-convex singleton, Borel measurability of endpoints via rational infima, equivariance, one-sided derivative characterization and both score implications (source Lemma 1). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: The population score and strong consistency
components.notes: Annex proves extended lambda well-defined/monotone/sign behavior (source Lemma 2) and strong consistency with extended-expectation strong law via Etemadi truncation (source Lemma 3). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: The full convex-score normal limit
components.notes: Annex gives triangular-array Lindeberg argument, strict/weak sandwich, two-half-normal case and B=0 case. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: A conditional smooth-score theorem and a consistency failure
components.notes: Annex proves derivative-average expansion, E psi=0, CLT with perturbation, and the (t^2-1)^2 inconsistency example. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: A positive clipping constant and a known scale
components.notes: Definition supplies rho_k, psi_k, midpoint estimator, known-scale form and k sigma threshold; unknown scale explicitly excluded. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Finite computation and its Winsorizing identity
components.notes: Annex proves affine piecewise formula, enumeration incl. flat pieces, Winsorizing mean identity (source p.79 (iii)), and both numerical examples (1/3 uniqueness, [-2,2]). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: The parameter and the limiting-risk order
components.notes: Definition supplies symmetric contamination class, location model, and the source limiting-risk criterion with operation order (source p.82). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Every symmetric contaminant, including cutoff atoms
components.notes: Annex proves strict decrease and unique root, one-sided derivatives with half endpoint weights, B(k) by integration by parts, worst-case bound and attainment, sigma^2 scaling. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Normalization, Fisher information and the score saddlepoint
components.notes: Annex proves unique k via C'(k)<0 (source normalization, p.82 Corollary), f_* normalization/membership/C^1 score, I_*=(1-eps)A(k)=1/V*, score saddlepoint via dominated differentiation and Cauchy-Schwarz, and uniqueness of the Fisher-information minimizer. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: The exact lower bound needed for all equivariant estimators
components.notes: Annex gives the van Trees style shrinking-prior proof with clipped estimator, explicit integration by parts, Fubini justification, and C-dependent bound. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: The original all-translation-equivariant minimax conclusion
components.notes: Annex proves lower bound at F_* with limits in stated order, attainment by clipped estimator with sup taken last, eps=0 endpoint, and the k->0 median limit. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: An exact contamination-bias equation
components.notes: Annex proves unique root, exact c_* bound and attainment, unboundedness for eps>=1/2, m_k formula, cubic-remainder expansion, and nonidentification of normal-component location via overlap theorem (source Sec.7 bias, p.82). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Cutoff atoms, variance inflation and the order of limits
components.notes: Annex derives the two slopes at the k atom, mean variance 1-eps+eps M^2 vs V*, and infinite finite-sample variance by Var(T)>=4p^2M^2 (source p.75 remark). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Convexity alone does not give a unique information minimizer
components.notes: Annex computes f, I(f)=4 pi^2, mixture information splitting on disjoint supports, vague compactness and convexity. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Worst-case errors for a fixed sample size
components.notes: Definition supplies sample space, i.i.d. product laws over classes, randomized tests, A/B worst-case errors, level problem, max-loss and weighted-risk problems incl. prior-weight case (Huber problems (i)-(iii), source p.1754). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Contamination and the source's total-variation convention
components.notes: Contamination classes, a_i, sup-event d_TV and ||.||_var=2 d_TV, equal-radius variation classes with delta=eps/2; matches source Sec.7 convention via eq.(7) mass eps/2 (source p.1758). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Overlap and the exact loss of uniform discrimination
components.notes: Annex proves variation identity, domination characterization of contamination members, m<=1 necessity/sufficiency (explicit common member), equal-fraction threshold m=(1-e)(1+d), TV intersection iff eps>=d, and the three constant-test optima with lower bounds. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: The original normalization equations and clipped pair
components.notes: Annex proves F,G continuity/monotonicity/uniqueness (source Lemma 1), membership, u<1/b and v<b via a_1F(1/b)=m>1, ratio branches incl. one-sided supports and null set, and recovers source equations (3) explicitly; one-zero-fraction endpoint cases stated in body. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: The distinct total-variation construction
components.notes: Annex proves g continuity/strict increase (source Lemma 3), 0<k_-<1/2<k_+<1, normalization, variation norm eps, clipped ratio branches reproducing source eq.(6)/(7); radius-zero and overlap boundaries handled. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Huber's order for every allowed contamination
components.notes: Annex proves outer inequalities for arbitrary (incl. singular) contaminants in both neighborhood types and the middle inequality from density likelihood order, plus weak-threshold limits (source Lemma 2 and its Sec.7 variant). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: A complete real-score coupling and product transfer
components.notes: Annex constructs quantile coupling on the real score space, independence across coordinates, well-definedness of products in each endpoint case, and the monotone-test attained sup/inf identities. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: All three fixed-sample minimax decisions
components.notes: Annex proves level-alpha NP optimality transfer incl. level 0 and 1, weighted pointwise minimization with zero-weight cases, and equalizer existence including perfect-discrimination threshold; zero-radius and 0*infinity tuple convention stated in body. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Larger neighborhoods and the source's sign-statistic limit
components.notes: Annex proves pointwise-extrema formulas, nesting of both neighborhood types, monotonicity of optimal power, monotonicity of c',c'', limits c'->1, c''->1 and the sign-count limit with the a.s. qualification (source Sec.4 remark). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Finite and normal contamination calculations
components.notes: Annex verifies every finite number (19/54, Q_0,Q_1, 10/19, 27/95, 19/100, table rows, 71/114, 8991/19000), general-e formula and threshold 1/3, TV pair and 1/4 power, and normal example D, eps_N separation and 1-Phi(1)/D. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Why the sample-level neighborhood matters
components.notes: Annex computes 2e(1-e) vs 0, shows the classes differ in both directions, and the repeated-draw 19/100 counterexample. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Separated ordered composite hypotheses
components.notes: Annex proves lower-set stochastic monotonicity from MLR (Tonelli), constructs measurable monotone extension r_* across support gaps, and proves the union-class order for contamination and variation; sequential transfer noted (source Sec.6 and Sec.7 last paragraph). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Sequential errors and finite expected termination
components.notes: Annex proves eta<1, the moment bounds under every neighborhood law, geometric tails, finite EN, and the exit-error comparisons by pathwise coupling (source Sec.5). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: The expected-size asymptotic under bounded clipping
components.notes: Annex proves uniform exit-probability bounds via stopped supermartingale with Fatou, the stopped-sum identity with integrability, uniform relative-error bounds without relative growth restriction, and both sup ratios ->1 (source Sec.5 expected-size result). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

duties.duty: The entire planned 'Misspecification, nonidentification and failures of routine inference' extent, preserved source-specific variants, prerequisite/argument/proof dependencies and examples were not read to a fulfillment conclusion in this bounded bookkeeping block. Located declarations are candidates, not completion credit.

evidence.label: thm:p15-robust-overlap (nonidentification of hypotheses when classes intersect)

duties.notes: Both routed files (body and annex) were read in full. All 29 linked components are covered with written proofs; source variants checked against Huber 1964 and Huber 1965. The section topics are present: misspecification (contamination and total-variation neighborhoods, asymmetric contamination target c(F), dependent-sample misspecification), nonidentification (intersecting hypothesis classes give only trivial power; the stipulated normal-component location is not identified under asymmetric contamination), and failures of routine inference (nominal size inflation 1/10->19/100, consistency failure without convexity, two-half-normal limits at cutoff atoms, infinite finite-sample variance, order-of-limits failure). Prerequisite references resolve to routed files.
